text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $83.5K with minimal daily movement, while Ethereum has slipped slightly to $2,506, suggesting modest weakness in altcoins relative to the flagship asset. Fear & Greed sits at 62 (greed territory) but has retreated 9 points over a week, indicating sentiment is cooling from recent highs despite still favoring risk-on positioning. BTC dominance at 59.2% and robust $748B daily volume reflect sustained conviction in Bitcoin as the market's primary anchor, though the broader softness across mid-caps signals caution is creeping back in.
